scope_note: Because the publisher reports 85% new material, content from the 2024 second edition must not be backdated to the 1979 first edition.
statement: Guilford identifies the 2024 'Cognitive Therapy of Depression' as a second edition with 85% new material and separately identifies the 1979 first edition.
statement_zh: Guilford 將 2024 年《Cognitive Therapy of Depression》標為第二版且含 85% 新材料，並另行標示 1979 年第一版。
